proposals.evidence: DEDR 497 gives Tamil ilai, Malayalam ila, Kannada ele/ela, Kota el and Tulu ele/ire ‘leaf’. Only this simple leaf stem is selected; the article's Gondi koṛk-ila ‘new leaf’ is a compound and is not reduced to a single inherited stem here. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
